text: I am standing outside my apartment right now and the smart lock will not open. I've tried the app three times and the keypad code. My kid is with me and it's raining.
The resident portal and all in-app lock controls for the entire property have been down since this morning. We have 40+ units affected and residents are calling the office.
Please advise: four units on the third floor (302, 304, 306, 308) are all reporting thermostats stuck at 62 degrees since last night, will not respond to app or panel changes.
Whole floor's thermostats are broken, not just mine, my neighbors on both sides are complaining too. All stuck on heat at max.
Following up again on ticket about unit 118's front door lock. This has been unresponsive for over a day now and the resident still cannot lock their door from outside.
It's been more than 24 hours and my leak sensor in the laundry closet is still showing as offline, nobody has come by. I don't know if there's water damage happening or not.
Bedroom thermostat shows offline in the app, has been since yesterday. Can't adjust temp remotely, have to use the manual panel.
Unit 219's thermostat has been stuck at 55 degrees for two days despite multiple reset attempts from our side, resident is asking for a fix.
App keeps logging me out every few hours and I have to keep re-entering my password, kind of annoying but I can still get back in fine.
I got locked out this morning but used the backup keypad code and got in fine. Just want to flag that the app-based unlock wasn't working at the time in case it's a bigger issue.
Had an app lock issue yesterday evening, used my keypad code as backup and got in without a problem. App unlock has worked fine again since this morning.
Resident in 112 reported being locked out last night, our office confirmed they used the backup code successfully within a few minutes and have had no issues since.
Got an emergency water alert on my phone at 2am saying my kitchen sensor detected a leak! I checked everything, floor is bone dry, no leak anywhere. Sensor now reads normal.
Leak sensor set off an alert this afternoon, I went and checked right away, turned out to just be condensation on the pipe, no actual water on the floor. It's reading fine now.
Got a leak alert for unit 208, went and inspected, false trigger from the sensor, no water present, floor and walls dry. Sensor is reporting normally again.
Third false water alarm this month, I check every time and there's never actually water. Sensor seems overly sensitive but not currently indicating any real problem.
How do I change my thermostat schedule so it's warmer on weekends? I can't find the option in the app.
I see a $15 charge on my statement labeled 'smart home add-on' that I don't recognize, can someone explain what this is for?
App crashes every single time I try to open the energy usage tab, happens consistently on my phone (iPhone 14, latest app version).

Resident in 407 says their front door lock has not responded to app, keypad, or physical key override attempts for the last 36 hours; they've been getting in through a side patio door in the meantime.
